event_description: User landed on the checkout page and a checkout session creation was triggered for a plan.
An error occurred while creating or redirecting to the payment checkout session.
User's subscription was confirmed as active on the checkout success page.
User clicked the subscribe or get-started CTA button on a pricing plan card.
User successfully created a new workspace from the Studio dashboard.
User opened an existing workspace from the Studio dashboard.
User deleted a workspace from the Studio dashboard.
User submitted a text prompt to generate a 2D preview image in the workspace.
User initiated a 3D model generation from an image in the workspace.
User submitted a text + image prompt to edit an existing image in the workspace.
A 3D model generation job completed successfully and the GLB is available.
A 3D model generation job failed, including GPU-offline and server errors.
User clicked the 'Start Generating' hero CTA button to enter the app.
